verdict.rationale: Docs describe serverless inference with 'no provisioning latency,' dedicated hardware offering 'better performance' and no rate limits, provisioned-throughput SLAs, prompt caching to cut latency, and SDK-level streaming (SSE) support — all directly relevant to TTFT/throughput. However there are no quantified latency/throughput benchmarks and community sentiment is mixed (one HN comment praises speed, another ranks Together at 'the bottom of the pile' vs Cerebras/DeepInfra/Hyperbolic for large-scale deployment), so this is not best-in-class corroborated performance. Missing for 10: independent latency/throughput benchmarks, resolution of the conflicting community performance ranking, and hands-on TTFT measurements.
